sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables Google Analytics for Firebase measurement components, switches Crashlytics and Firebase/Google-Analytics collection off via the official opt-out flags, and removes the install-referrer permission. FCM push is kept.

Fitbit ships no ad SDK or ad placement; this additionally disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services / install-referrer permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.
